# Case 4471 — Wire Transfer Analysis

Acme Corp wired $2,000,000 to Beta Ltd on 2026-07-30. The company then transferred
funds to Gamma Holdings the next day.

John Doe is the nominee director of Beta Ltd. Acme Corp controls Gamma Holdings, and
Gamma Holdings is the beneficial owner of Delta Trust.

Note: Beta Ltd did not transfer any funds to Omega Bank. Investigators believe Acme
Corp may be linked to Sigma Partners.
